metadata.description: harnist — Tuist-style harness modules and dashboard for Claude Code

plugins.name: harnist
plugins.description: Per-project skills, plugins and MCP for Claude Code: audit the global scope by real usage, archive with stubs, generate .claude/ from modules, and see it all in a local dashboard.

plugins.name: lens
plugins.description: Langfuse-lite for Claude Code: a mod that records what each session loaded and used, per-request cache hits, turn scores and cost — live in a /lens pane and a line under the prompt, with a lens-review skill that turns the numbers into harness fixes. harnist view shows the traces.

plugins.name: runtime
plugins.description: harnist runtime mod: loads each subagent by its role — trims the skill list, MCP notes and CLAUDE.md per subagent type, enforces spawn limits and per-role tool bans, from one JSON file per repo.
